What is Soundraw?

Royalty-free music generator built for video creators, with a distinctive editing model: you generate a track then adjust its energy and instrumentation bar by bar on a timeline to match your video's pacing.

Best for

Royalty-free background music timed precisely to video edits.

Main features

  • Generate by mood, genre, length and tempo
  • bar-by-bar energy editing to match video cuts
  • instrument-level muting and arrangement control
  • exact-length generation matching your video duration
  • unlimited generation on paid plans
  • royalty-free licence covering YouTube, TikTok and commercial use
  • no Content ID claims
  • Premiere Pro extension
  • team plans.

Practical use cases

  • Scoring a YouTube video with music that matches cut timing
  • generating a track of an exact required length
  • adjusting music energy to build to a video's climax
  • producing consistent background music across a channel without licence hassle.

Who is it for?

  • YouTubers, video editors, social media creators, marketing video teams and agencies.

Pricing, free access & limits

Subscription with unlimited generation; no per-track credits

Plans described in the source

Free to generate and preview, but downloads require a paid plan. Creator around $19.99/mo ($16.99 annually) with unlimited downloads for one user. Artist tier around $29.99/mo for additional rights. Business/Enterprise plans quoted for teams and broadcast use. Annual billing roughly 15-20% cheaper. Some single-track purchase options have been offered.

Free plan

Free to generate and preview; downloads require payment.

Free trial

The free preview tier serves as the trial.

Usage limits to consider

Unlimited generation and downloads on paid tiers - there is no credit metering, which is unusual and favourable. Free tier allows generation and preview but no download. Licence scope varies by tier (creator vs broadcast/advertising use).

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Unlimited downloads with no credit metering is genuinely rare and makes budgeting trivial
  • the bar-by-bar energy editor solves the real problem video editors have - music that does not match the cut
  • royalty-free licence with no Content ID claims removes a recurring YouTube headache
  • the Premiere extension keeps you in the timeline.

Limitations to consider

  • No vocals - instrumental only
  • output is competent background music rather than distinctive composition, and tracks can sound generic
  • no MIDI export so no deep editing
  • you licence rather than own the music, and the licence ends if you cancel in some scenarios (check terms carefully)
  • smaller style library than a stock music service.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web
  • Adobe Premiere Pro extension
  • API for enterprise

Languages

  • Instrumental focus; interface in English and Japanese

API access

Yes - Soundraw API for enterprise and platform integration

Integrations and exports

  • Adobe Premiere Pro extension, direct download to editing tools, YouTube-safe licensing

Evaluation notes

Check whether your licence survives cancellation for already-published videos - this varies by plan and is the most important term to verify. The bar-by-bar editor is the feature to test against your actual video workflow.
